entry.title: Analyzing logs manually?
entry.summary:
This is how I built my first script to detect attacks in Python.
How many hours do security analysts spend manually reviewing logs? 🛑 As a Cybersecurity student, I wanted to understand how to automate this task and put theory into practice. That's why I've been working on LogSentinel-Lite, a lightweight Python script designed to assist with Blue Team tasks and threat analysis. 🛡️💻 📊 It reads and parses log files (such as authentication logs). 🔍 It automatically detects suspicious patterns, such as potential brute-force attacks based on multiple failed login attempts from the same IP address. ⚡ It generates a clear report in the console to expedite incident triage. It's a simple project, but ideal for taking your first steps in detection and automation engineering with Python. I'd love to hear your thoughts or suggestions for improvements! 🚀 🔗 You can see the complete code, documentation, and try it out in my GitHub repository: https://github.com/soolaczz/LogSentinel

entry.title: How to Test a Game Controller Online in Under a Minute
entry.summary: If your character keeps drifting in-game or a button feels unresponsive, the fastest way to check is with an online gamepad tester — no downloads needed. Start by connecting your controller with a USB cable (or Bluetooth), then open the tester in your browser and press any button. Most modern browsers support the Gamepad API, so your controller should be detected instantly. To check for stick drift, watch the thumbstick readouts while your hands are completely off the controller. The values should sit at zero. If they wander or jitter, your stick is drifting. A healthy stick returns to exactly zero and moves smoothly through its full range when you rotate it slowly. For buttons and triggers, press each one individually and confirm the on-screen indicator lights up once per press. Watch out for buttons that trigger without being pressed, or fail to register at all — both are signs of a worn switch. Test the D-pad and shoulder buttons the same way. Finally, check the deadzone: tiny movements at the edges of the stick's range should read near zero on a well-calibrated controller. I run my controllers through this free online gamepad tester whenever something feels off. It shows buttons, sticks, and triggers in real time, and it takes less than a minute to confirm whether a controller is healthy or needs replacing.

entry.title: How to Fix Mixed-Format Dates in Excel and Google Sheets (DD/MM vs MM/DD, Text Dates)
entry.summary: You open a CSV that someone exported from a UK or European system, and the date column is a mess. Some cells are right-aligned, some are left-aligned. 15/04/2024 sits there as text. 03/04/2024 looks fine but is now March 4 instead of April 3. Sorting and filtering are broken, and a pivot by month is wrong without any warning. Here's what happened and how to fix it in Excel and Google Sheets.
